name: com.enioka.scanner.sdk.athesi.SPA43LTE.AthesiHHTProvider
description: When Enioka Scan searches an Athesi SPA43LTE handheld for its built-in scanner, this service provides the device's barcode reader to the app.
disableEffect: Barcode scanning through the built-in reader on an Athesi SPA43LTE device stops working.
